name: Thorg

facts.text: Thorg: level 42, a spider body (model 117) at size 102, the largest spider in the caves (arachnids are 63), at about 29,300/34,720 (z 14,536) in the passages west of King Vian's hall with ursine warriors (36-39), a shaman (38) and an arachnid near him; respawn 180 seconds; a plain spawn.
Living Server lore: Thorg as King Vian's champion, a spider of the western dark the ursine feed.

story:
Every account of King Vian's hall names Thorg, his champion, standing in the passage beside it where the king can see him. What the accounts leave out, Hervelina says, is that Thorg is not a bear. He is a spider, the largest in the caves, larger than any arachnid of the western dark he came out of, and the ursine warriors stand about him the way grooms stand about a war-horse, with a shaman to see to him.

The ursine tell it as a story of the old quarrel. When the tribe split, each side put up a champion, as the old families of the mainland did, and the champion of the side that lost was the greatest ursine warrior of his day. Vian's grandfather did not put up an ursine against him. He went into the western dark with a thrall on a rope and came back with Thorg, and it was over before the torches had burned down, and the side that lost went into collars. Since then Thorg has been fed by the king's own hand.

Hervelina's view is that a king's champion should be of his people, and that the champion Vian keeps tells you what his people are to him. The thralls of the south hall carry Thorg's meals. They say he is gentle with them, which is the worst thing about him.
legend: Thorg (42) is the biggest spider in Treibh Caillte (about 29.3k/34.7k), kept by the ursine in the passages west of King Vian's hall, with ursine warriors (36-39), a shaman (38) and an arachnid near him. Clear the ursine first. Helminth (36) is about 2,000 away on the level below. A group of low to mid 40s. Plain spawn, no script, 3-minute respawn.
